import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n, sum = 0, num, i = 0;
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        if (n > 0) {
            do {
                num = scanner.nextInt();
                sum += num;
                ++i;
            } while (i < n);
        }
        System.out.println(sum / n);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
